description: KingstVIS Virtual Instruments Studio. Logic analyzer / oscilloscope / protocol analyzer software for Kingst Electronics instruments (LA series, VirtualScale series). Free, fully-featured demo mode without hardware.
notes: The installer is an Advanced Installer EXE wrapping a per-machine MSI (WinUSB driver packages included).

A UAC elevation prompt will appear during install/uninstall (silent MSI mode disables auto-elevation). This is unavoidable: the embedded DIFxApp driver custom actions are unconditionally scheduled for elevation (MsiProcessDriver condition: VersionNT >= 50), same as extras/vcredist-aio etc. and everything in the nonportable bucket.
To reduce UAC prompts, install gsudo (scoop install gsudo) and run 'gsudo cache on' before install/uninstall; the elevation is then cached for ~10 minutes.

If KingstVIS is already installed system-wide, the MSI enters maintenance mode and ignores APPDIR (files will NOT be placed in the Scoop directory). Uninstall the existing copy first for a clean Scoop install.
Version metadata source: https://www.qdkingst.com/en/download (no dedicated JSON API; installer URL pattern: https://www.qdkingst.com/kfs/KingstVIS_v<version>.exe)

script: if (!(Test-Path "$dir\KingstVIS.exe")) { error 'KingstVIS.exe not found in install dir; the MSI may have entered maintenance mode (existing system-wide install detected).'; throw 'install failed' }

post_install: # Remove the per-machine Start Menu AND Desktop shortcuts created by the MSI (keep only the Scoop Apps shortcut).
# The elevated msiexec child may finish writing shortcuts long after the installer stub exits,
# so delete now AND keep a background watcher for 5 minutes to remove them whenever they (re)appear.
